messages.subject: runGadget in a separate R process but show in Rstudio Viewer?
parts: I submitted a package to CRAN with an Rstudio addin for cloning, branching, and assignment management using git (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/gitgadget/index.html). If works fine but it would be nice if it could (1) be run in a separate R process so it doesn't block the console (ala Rmarkdown) and (2) still show in the Rstudio viewer. I've tried using system(...) with runGadget and runApp but Rstudio freezes when I try that. Is something like this feasible with runGadget or runApp?
